limits.breaker: Loop breaker, always on: a chain deeper than {relayMax} hops wakes nobody, and {repeats} identical messages from one Bot pause the chat until a person writes.
limits.intro: Counters that bound a conversation and a run. A blank field uses the default. A change applies to the next Bot message and to runs that start afterwards; running and parked runs keep the limits they started with.
limits.invalid: {name}: enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
limits.key.continuationLimit: Continuations after running out of turns
limits.key.continuationWindowHours: Hours to answer a continuation request
limits.key.relayCountMax: Relay cap (hops in one message chain)
limits.key.turnBudget: Turn budget (Bot messages per chat since the last human message)
limits.key.turnBudgetResetMinutes: Minutes until a chat paused by its turn budget resumes by itself
limits.offNeedsBudget: This workspace requires a weekly or cumulative budget (Costs page) before a limit can be off.
limits.source.default_no_backstop: default; this workspace requires a budget for off
limits.switch.requireBudgetForOff: Require a budget for unlimited limits
limits.switch.volumeBreaker: Pause a chat after {botMessages} Bot messages since the last human message
limits.title: Execution limits
